chunks: "None of you should spit in salat (prayer) in front of his face, nor to his right; rather, let him spit to his left and beneath his left foot."

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual act of worship in which this etiquette applies
key_terms.الْيُسْرَى: the left one, i.e. the left foot
key_terms.يَبْزُقَنَّ: should spit; an emphatic prohibition here in the negative form

ai.seo_question: Where should a person spit during salat (prayer) according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives an etiquette and ruling related to conduct during salat (prayer), forbidding spitting in front of oneself or to the right. It directs that if necessary, one should spit to the left and beneath the left foot, reflecting reverence and proper comportment in worship.
